```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ── 预实验 ────────────────────────────────────────
pilot_cat    <- bind_rows(s1_cat, s2_cat)       %>% mutate(group = "Categorization")
pilot_sensor <- bind_rows(s1_sensor, s2_sensor) %>% mutate(group = "Sensorimotor")
pilot_voe    <- bind_rows(s1_voe, s2_voe)       %>% mutate(group = "VoE")

pilot_all <- bind_rows(pilot_cat, pilot_sensor, pilot_voe) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor", "VoE")))

pilot_table <- pilot_all %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    N                  = n(),
    `T_encode M`       = round(mean(mean_T_encode,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `T_encode SD`      = round(sd(mean_T_encode,      na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_onset M`       = round(mean(mean_RT_onset,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_onset SD`      = round(sd(mean_RT_onset,      na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_critical M`    = round(mean(mean_RT_critical, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `RT_critical SD`   = round(sd(mean_RT_critical,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `ACC M`            = round(mean(mean_ACC,         na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `ACC SD`           = round(sd(mean_ACC,           na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_onset M`      = round(mean(mean_IES_onset,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_onset SD`     = round(sd(mean_IES_onset,     na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_critical M`   = round(mean(mean_IES_critical, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `IES_critical SD`  = round(sd(mean_IES_critical,   na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )

cat("=== 预实验 Descriptive Statistics ===\n")
print(pilot_table)

# 导出
write.csv(pilot_table,
          file = file.path(folder_path, "descriptive_pilot.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n导出完成！\n")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# 整理数据
plot_dat <- pilot_all %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "VoE", "Sensorimotor"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, 
                mean_ACC, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical) %>%
  mutate(mean_ACC = mean_ACC * 100) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, 
             mean_ACC, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "mean_T_encode"     ~ "T_encode (s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_onset"     ~ "RT_onset (s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_critical"  ~ "RT_critical (s)",
      measure == "mean_ACC"          ~ "ACC (%)",
      measure == "mean_IES_onset"    ~ "IES_onset",
      measure == "mean_IES_critical" ~ "IES_critical"
    ),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c("T_encode (s)", "RT_onset (s)", 
                                          "RT_critical (s)", "ACC (%)",
                                          "IES_onset", "IES_critical"))
  )

sem_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(group, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem  = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_pointrange(data = sem_dat,
                  aes(x = group, y = mean,
                      ymin = mean - sem,
                      ymax = mean + sem),
                  color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Categorization" = "#4E79A7",
                                "VoE"            = "#59A14F",
                                "Sensorimotor"   = "#F28E2B")) +
  labs(title = "Performance by Group (Box Plot with SEM)", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_blank(),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x    = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "boxplot_by_group.png"),
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("图已保存！\n")
```

```{r}
library(bestNormalize)

# 用 orderNorm 单独变换 T_encode
on_T_encode <- orderNorm(all_dat$mean_T_encode)
all_dat$bc_T_encode <- on_T_encode$x.t
shapiro.test(all_dat$bc_T_encode)
```

```{r}
library(bestNormalize)

# IES_onset
bn_IES_onset <- bestNormalize(all_dat$mean_IES_onset)
all_dat$bc_IES_onset <- bn_IES_onset$x.t
cat("IES_onset 变换：", class(bn_IES_onset$chosen_transform)[1], "\n")
print(shapiro.test(all_dat$bc_IES_onset))

# IES_critical
bn_IES_critical <- bestNormalize(all_dat$mean_IES_critical)
all_dat$bc_IES_critical <- bn_IES_critical$x.t
cat("IES_critical 变换：", class(bn_IES_critical$chosen_transform)[1], "\n")
print(shapiro.test(all_dat$bc_IES_critical))

# RT_onset
bn_RT_onset <- bestNormalize(all_dat$mean_RT_onset)
all_dat$bc_RT_onset <- bn_RT_onset$x.t
cat("RT_onset 变换：", class(bn_RT_onset$chosen_transform)[1], "\n")
print(shapiro.test(all_dat$bc_RT_onset))

#RT_critical
all_dat$bc_RT_critical <- orderNorm(all_dat$mean_RT_critical)$x.t
cat("RT_critical 变换：orderNorm\n")
print(shapiro.test(all_dat$bc_RT_critical))

# T_encode 用 orderNorm
on_T_encode <- orderNorm(all_dat$mean_T_encode)
all_dat$bc_T_encode <- on_T_encode$x.t
cat("T_encode 变换：orderNorm\n")
print(shapiro.test(all_dat$bc_T_encode))
```


```{r}
cat("=== Pearson 相关：bc_T_encode vs 变换后各 DV ===\n")

dvs_cor <- list(
  "bc_IES_onset"    = all_dat$bc_IES_onset,
  "bc_IES_critical" = all_dat$bc_IES_critical,
  "bc_RT_onset"     = all_dat$bc_RT_onset,
  "bc_RT_critical"  = all_dat$bc_RT_critical
)

for (dv_name in names(dvs_cor)) {
  result <- cor.test(all_dat$bc_T_encode, dvs_cor[[dv_name]])
  cat(paste0("\nbc_T_encode vs ", dv_name, ":\n"))
  cat(paste0("r = ", round(result$estimate, 3),
             ", t(", result$parameter, ") = ", round(result$statistic, 3),
             ", p = ", format(result$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))
}

# ACC 用 Spearman
cat("\n=== Spearman 相关：T_encode vs ACC ===\n")
print(cor.test(all_dat$mean_T_encode, all_dat$mean_ACC, method = "spearman"))
```

```{r}
library(car)

run_ancova <- function(dv, covariate = "bc_T_encode") {
  cat(paste0("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("DV = ", dv, "\n"))
  cat(paste0(strrep("=", 50), "\n"))
  
  # Levene's Test
  cat("\n--- Levene's Test ---\n")
  print(leveneTest(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group")), data = all_dat))
  
  # 平行性假设
  cat("\n--- 平行性假设 ---\n")
  print(summary(aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group * ", covariate)),
                    data = all_dat)))
  
  # ANCOVA
  cat("\n--- ANCOVA ---\n")
  model <- aov(as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ group + ", covariate)),
               data = all_dat)
  print(summary(model))
  
  cat("\n--- Type III SS ---\n")
  print(Anova(model, type = "III"))
  
  cat("\n--- Post-hoc Tukey HSD ---\n")
  print(TukeyHSD(model, "group"))
}

run_ancova("bc_IES_onset")
run_ancova("bc_IES_critical")
run_ancova("bc_RT_onset")
run_ancova("bc_RT_critical")
```


```{r}
# 对 ACC 取秩再做 ANCOVA
all_dat$rank_ACC <- rank(all_dat$mean_ACC)

rank_model <- aov(rank_ACC ~ group + mean_T_encode, data = all_dat)

cat("=== 秩 ANCOVA ===\n")
rank_anova <- Anova(rank_model, type = "III")
print(rank_anova)

cat("\n=== Partial eta squared ===\n")
rank_eta_p2 <- rank_anova[, "Sum Sq"] /
  (rank_anova[, "Sum Sq"] + rank_anova["Residuals", "Sum Sq"])
rank_eta_p2 <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(rank_anova),
  eta_p2 = round(rank_eta_p2, 3),
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  filter(term != "Residuals")
print(rank_eta_p2)

cat("\n=== Post-hoc ===\n")
rank_tukey <- TukeyHSD(rank_model, "group")
print(rank_tukey)

cat("\n=== Post-hoc eta squared ===\n")
rank_tukey_eta <- as.data.frame(rank_tukey$group)
rank_tukey_eta$contrast <- rownames(rank_tukey_eta)

mse_rank <- deviance(rank_model) / df.residual(rank_model)
n_by_group <- table(all_dat$group)

rank_tukey_eta <- rank_tukey_eta %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    group_1 = strsplit(contrast, "-")[[1]][1],
    group_2 = strsplit(contrast, "-")[[1]][2],
    se = sqrt(mse_rank * (1 / n_by_group[group_1] + 1 / n_by_group[group_2])),
    t_value = diff / se,
    eta_sq = round(t_value^2 / (t_value^2 + df.residual(rank_model)), 3)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(contrast, p_adj = `p adj`, eta_sq)

print(rank_tukey_eta)
```
IES_onset（ANCOVA）

Type III：group 显著，F(2, 86) = 3.47, p = .036，协变量不显著 p = .198
Post-hoc：Sensorimotor > Categorization (p = .016)，Sensorimotor > VoE (p < .001)，Cat vs VoE 不显著


IES_critical（ANCOVA）

Type III：group 不显著，F(2, 86) = 2.41, p = .096，协变量不显著 p = .092
Post-hoc：仅 Sensorimotor > VoE 显著 (p < .001)


RT_onset（ANCOVA）

Type III：group 不显著，F(2, 86) = 2.20, p = .117，协变量边界显著 p = .055
Post-hoc：仅 Sensorimotor > VoE 显著 (p < .001)


RT_critical（ANCOVA）

Type III：group 不显著，F(2, 86) = 2.30, p = .106，协变量显著 p = .039
Post-hoc：仅 Sensorimotor > VoE 显著 (p < .001)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# ── Step 1: 整理原始数据长格式 ───────────────────────
plot_dat <- all_dat %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Categorization", "VoE", "Sensorimotor"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical,
                mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, mean_ACC) %>%
  mutate(mean_ACC = mean_ACC * 100) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_IES_onset, mean_IES_critical,
             mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical, mean_ACC),
    names_to  = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "mean_IES_onset"    ~ "IES[onset]",
      measure == "mean_IES_critical" ~ "IES[critical]",
      measure == "mean_RT_onset"     ~ "RT[onset]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_RT_critical"  ~ "RT[critical]~(s)",
      measure == "mean_ACC"          ~ "ACC~('%')"
    ),
    measure = factor(measure, levels = c(
      "IES[onset]", "IES[critical]",
      "RT[onset]~(s)", "RT[critical]~(s)", "ACC~('%')"
    ))
  )

# ── Step 2: 计算均值和 SEM ────────────────────────────
sem_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  group_by(group, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem  = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ── Step 3: 显著性标注 ────────────────────────────────
comparisons_list <- list(
  "IES[onset]"       = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "*"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"), "***")),
  "IES[critical]"    = list(list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"), "***")),
  "RT[onset]~(s)"    = list(list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"), "***")),
  "RT[critical]~(s)" = list(list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"), "***")),
  "ACC~('%')"        = list(list(c("Categorization", "Sensorimotor"), "**"),
                            list(c("VoE", "Sensorimotor"), "**"))
)

# ── Step 4: 配色 ─────────────────────────────────────
nature_colors <- c(
  "Categorization" = "#4DBBD5",
  "VoE"            = "#00A087",
  "Sensorimotor"   = "#E64B35"
)
group_labels <- c(
  "Categorization" = "Concept Verification",
  "VoE"            = "Plausibility Assessment",
  "Sensorimotor"   = "Affordance Recognition"
)

# ── Step 5: 循环画每个子图 ───────────────────────────
plot_list <- list()

for (m in levels(sem_dat$measure)) {
  d      <- sem_dat %>% filter(measure == m)
  comps  <- lapply(comparisons_list[[m]], `[[`, 1)
  labels <- lapply(comparisons_list[[m]], `[[`, 2)
  y_max  <- max(d$mean + d$sem) * 1.5

  p_sub <- ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group)) +

    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6,
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +

    geom_signif(
      comparisons = comps,
      annotations = unlist(labels),
      y_position  = seq(max(d$mean + d$sem) * 1.1,
                        max(d$mean + d$sem) * 1.35,
                        length.out = length(comps)),
      tip_length  = 0.02,
      textsize    = 3,
      vjust       = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = nature_colors,
      labels = group_labels,
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, y_max)) +

    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = parse(text = m)) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.line       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.y    = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      plot.margin     = margin(6, 4, 0, 4)
    )

  plot_list[[m]] <- p_sub
}

# ── Step 6: 合并：5个子图一行，自动收集 legend ───────
combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1, ncol = 5, guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.direction  = "horizontal",
    legend.title      = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size   = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x  = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.margin     = margin(t = -2, b = 0),
    plot.margin       = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

print(combined)

# ── Step 7: 保存 ─────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "pilot_barchart.pdf"),
  plot     = combined,
  width    = 200,
  height   = 90,
  units    = "mm",
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "pilot_barchart.png"),
  plot     = combined,
  width    = 200,
  height   = 90,
  units    = "mm",
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)
cat("图已保存！\n")
```
